description_en: Queries the routes that point to a network instance connection. The routes are retrieved from the route table of a network instance that is attached to an Enterprise Edition transit router
description_zh: 调用ListCenChildInstanceRouteEntriesToAttachment接口查询企业版转发路由器下网络实例路由表中指向网络实例连接的路由条目
kebab_example: aliyun cbn list-cen-child-instance-route-entries-to-attachment --max-results 20 --next-token FFmyTO70tTpLG6I3FmYAXGKPd0000 --cen-id cen-dc4vwznpwbobrl0000 --child-instance-route-table-id vtb-bp174d1gje79u1g4t0000 --transit-router-attachment-id tr-attach-r6g0m3epjehw570000 --route-filter '[{"Value":["10.0.0.0/8"],"Key":"prefix-exact-match"}]' --service-type TR --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListCenChildInstanceRouteEntriesToAttachment

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. The default value is 20
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时，每次显示的条目数。默认值为20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The token for the next page of results.

If this is your first query, leave this parameter empty.

If a next query is required, set the value to the NextToken value returned from the last call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the CEN instance
parameters.name: cen_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the route table of the network instance
parameters.name: child_instance_route_table_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the network instance connection
parameters.name: transit_router_attachment_id

fields.help_en:
The route matching mode.

prefix-exact-match: exact match
fields.help_zh:
路由匹配值模式。
prefix-exact-match：完全匹配
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: A list of destination CIDR blocks
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The filter for the destination CIDR block
parameters.name: route_filter

parameters.help_en: The type of the managed routing service. If this parameter is empty, the route is not managed. Set the value to TR. This value indicates that the route is managed by a transit router
parameters.help_zh: 路由托管的类型。如果该字段为空，即表示该路由没有被托管。取值：TR，表示托管类型为转发路由器类型
parameters.name: service_type
